notes: Amendment No. 2 (final amendment) to EVF's Schedule TO reporting final results. The attached press release also reports results for EVG, EFT and EFR; this extraction covers only the filer/subject EVF. The offer was undersubscribed: EVF will purchase all shares properly tendered and the pro-ration factor is printed as N/A, so proration_factor_pct is null (100% would be an inference). commencement_date is the Offer to Purchase date (June 29, 2021, also the initial Schedule TO filing date); no explicit commencement date is stated. The exhibit index lists a 'Standstill Agreement dated May 12, 2021' (previously filed), but the excerpt does not state why the tender exists, so trigger_origin is null. Conditions are incorporated by reference and not stated.
